beats.text: This is the Saturn V. The rocket that took people to the Moon.
It's 111 meters tall. Nine tenths of its weight is fuel.
Stage one has five giant engines. It burns for two and a half minutes, then drops away.
Stage two takes over and carries it almost to orbit.
Stage three reaches orbit, then fires again to go to the Moon.
Only the tiny capsule at the top came home.
Follow for more, and see how everything works.
